Cloudflare.__comment: Disabled by default. IP allowlist changes still persist to the DB either way; set Enabled=true + ApiToken + ZoneId to also sync to a real Cloudflare zone. CustomRuleHostname is what actually blocks traffic (the Custom Rule / Rulesets API) — leave empty to skip that part even when Enabled=true. AccountId + IpListName switch that sync onto Cloudflare Lists (no per-expression size ceiling) — leave either empty to keep the inline-IP fallback, which is size-limited (see docs/ec2-staging.md §7). The API token needs an Account-level 'Lists Edit' permission in addition to the Zone-level ones already required for the other two.

Cookie.__comment: httpOnly session cookie for the browser Admin UI. SameSite=Lax suits dev + a same-registrable-domain UI/API; set to None (forces Secure) only for a cross-site UI/API split. Secure omitted ⇒ defaults false in Development, true otherwise.
Cookie.Name: cpe_ops_session

Blockchain.__comment: The asset catalog. MUST stay byte-identical to MerchantGateway's Blockchain:Assets — the AssetId is the key money is denominated by, so a host disagreeing about it would resolve a different asset for the same funds. Without this section AddConfigurationAssetCatalog registers an EMPTY catalog, and every Ops screen that resolves an asset degrades silently: reads render null coin/network, and the per-merchant fee/limit/threshold setters reject valid input as an 'unknown coin'.

Cors.__comment: Browser origins allowed to call this API with credentials (the session cookie). Empty ⇒ same-origin only. MUST be exact origins (scheme+host+port), never '*', because AllowCredentials forbids the wildcard. Set per deployment, e.g. the Admin UI origin.

Sweep.__comment: DEFAULTS only, and they must match the money host's: a chain's settings row is created from whichever host reads it first, and both then read the same row. Staff edits (PUT /ops/sweeps/settings/{chain}) are stored and take precedence from then on.
